question: Which deluding and agitating powers are invoked to grant perpetual protection?
premises: The all-deluding power is invoked with the plea 'may protect'.
The all-agitating power is likewise invoked with the plea 'may protect'.
The invocation specifies that this protection is to be constant.
inference: Both the all-deluding and all-agitating feminine powers are called upon to provide continuous protection.
uncertainties: The specific identities or iconographic forms of sammohinī and saṅkṣobhiṇī are not specified in this verse.
plain_english: May the all-deluding one protect; may the all-agitating one always protect.
